title: Receipt
description: An issuer's signed record of an action (a SCITT Signed Statement), signed v2= (VAOS 2.0) or v3= (VAOS 3.0). The schema checks shape only: a verifier checks the signature, the content hash and that every repeated field equals the same field of the parsed canonical. Other fields are allowed, since each repeats a field of the canonical (VAOS 2.0 section 7).

canonical.description: The exact UTF-8 text that was signed: a JSON object.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical, optionally prefixed with sha256: (VAOS 2.0 section 7): 64 or 71 characters.
